exact: negative regulation of VLDL particle clearance

definition: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency or extent of very-low-density lipoprotein particle clearance. Very-low-density lipoprotein particle clearance is the process in which a very-low-density lipoprotein particle is removed from the blood via receptor-mediated endocytosis and its constituent parts degraded.
label: negative regulation of very-low-density lipoprotein particle clearance
